svg.title: Merge sort trace on array [38,27,43,3,9,82,10]
svg.desc: Full divide and conquer tree showing splits down to single elements then merges back to sorted array
svg.text: Time: O(n log n) always · Space: O(n) auxiliary · Stable sort · Divide until size=1, then merge back
Merge step: compare front elements of both halves, take smaller → repeat until all merged
